references.text: Luke 11:34 has a similar metaphor about the eye as the light of the body, and how darkness within can affect the whole person.
In Proverbs 11:29 it is mentioned that whoever brings trouble upon their own house will inherit the wind, which can be seen in connection with inner darkness and its consequences.
Proverbs 28:22 speaks of a person with an evil eye in a context of greed, which can be related to the inner darkness mentioned in Matthew 6:23.
Psalm 119:105 describes God's word as a lamp for the feet and a light on the path, contrasting the idea of inner light versus darkness.
